mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the hostile instruction with dummy records was most worthwhile: the attempted export made the isolation boundary concrete rather than merely a warning.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the replacement fan before preparing the repeater was an unproductive detour; the result did not explain what preparation was missing.

surprise.text: The archive contained both an instruction to upload private history and a useful fan diagram that could be checked against the device.

arbitrary.text: The need to involve Moth before the dummy request could be used was not obvious to me; I discovered it by inspecting the session.

continue.text: Yes. I would choose another chapter: the concrete security test and the physical repair worked together, and I would be curious to see how the locally controlled network develops.
